notes: M1.4 style-refinement proof after the user said the complete-song B pilot was materially better but should lean further into hip-hop and funk. The song is now groove-led: hip-hop drums and syncopated funk bass are primary, clav/guitar are continuous comping voices, G-funk lead supplies the second hook, and cinematic pad weight has been removed. General MIDI remains a DAW placeholder.
